description: PTC - PROPOSTA RETE PISTE CICLABILI is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.cittametropolitana.na.it. Metropolitan City of Naples. The layer represents a general identification of the cycle network of the metropolitan city, with the forecast of sections and segments able to network the few initiatives already under construction; the overall network connects the Stabiese area, the nolana area, the acerrana area, the Giuglianese area and the flegrea area, using ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTC — PROPOSED BIKE LANES NETWORK" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Piano Territoriale Coordinamento, Città Metropolitana di Napoli, PTC, Utilizzo del territorio, piste ciclabili, rete infrastrutturale mobilità. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
